title: History index schemas
responsibility: Defines the stored history index, revision coverage, growth, benchmark series and legacy report shapes.

outputs.name: indexedRecordSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema for attached record identity, pass/fail status, profile, finish time, nullable base, validity and problems.

outputs.name: indexedRevisionSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema for source revision metadata, parents, branches, retention, coverage, gaps, records, reason count, legacy ids, optional direct changes and detail-file path.

outputs.name: benchmarkSeriesSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema grouping one unit/workload/metric/target into series separated by profile, unit, method and comparison context, with commit/record/value points and an incompatibility flag.

outputs.name: legacyMediaSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema for legacy media provenance, original file metadata, nullable hash/size and resolved media path or gap.

outputs.name: legacyEntrySchema
outputs.description: Strict schema preserving a legacy report’s original outcome, times and revision, optional linked commit, checks and media.

outputs.name: historyIndexSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 index schema containing history refs, branches, revisions, unit growth and reviews, benchmarks, profiles, legacy reports, truncation and problems.

outputs.name: indexedExplanationSchema
outputs.description: The same explanation schema used for stored change reasons; indexing does not alter the reason.
